Free templates to meet all your business and personal needs

name: Smallpdf
summary: Web platform with 30+ PDF tools to convert, compress, edit, merge, split and sign documents.
description: Online PDF workspace with 30+ document tools: PDF to Word and other format conversions, OCR, PDF/A, merge, split, rotate, compress, edit (text, shapes, annotations, freehand), electronic signatures and an AI PDF tool. A free templates library adds invoices, contracts and business templates. Free plan with limited downloads, plus Pro, Team (2-100 seats) and Business plans; also a mobile app and Chrome, Google Workspace and Dropbox integrations.
contains: 30+ PDF tools to convert, compress and edit documents
free templates library: invoices (69), contracts & agreements (185), business templates (46)
plans: Free, Pro, Team (2-100 seats) and Business; 7-day free trial
trusted by 1.7 billion people since 2013; available in 24 languages
ISO/IEC 27001 certified, GDPR, CCPA and nFADP compliant (stated)
